messages:
support_lead: Customer Lexico reporting repeated 504s to /v1/generate during today's peak — started ~11:03 PST, volume spike. Customer attached curl + req-id. Please triage.
sre_dean: On it. Any tenant id + sample req-id?
support_lead: tenant=lexico-prod-33, req-id=req_0a1b2c. p95 jumped from ~400ms to 3.2s then 504s.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary completed by @eng_runtime_liz at 10:57 UTC for runtime kernel patch v2.1.3
eng_runtime_liz: I pushed a small kernel/fusion tweak earlier. Rolling back if correlated. Can we confirm which host served req_0a1b2c?
sre_dean: Pulling metrics. queue_depth metric shows a sharp spike at 11:02:45 — peak ~1624 (limit=1000). batcher_pending_tokens backlog increased ~480s window. drop_rate jumped to 4.3%.
eng_ml_tara: That pattern looks like continuous-batcher backlog + kvcache cold/eviction. Also saw many short requests hitting quantized variant rw-cpm-13b-q4 which has slower small-seq path.
support_lead: Customer provided this repro snippet:
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT' \\n  -d '{ "model": "rw-cpm-13b-deploy", "input": "..." }'
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
x-request-id: req_0a1b2c
```
eng_runtime_liz: Can someone grep ingress-gw-05 logs for req_0a1b2c? I suspect sticky routing and that host is CPU-bound and starved by batching.
sre_dean: Confirmed: ingress-gw-05 had sustained high RPS and routing table shows sticky affinity to eu-west pool for lexico-prod-33. Autoscale didn't kick — policy uses aggregated CPU, not queue depth.
eng_platform_kevin: Immediate mitigations I recommend: (1) increase tenant queue capacity floor, (2) disable continuous batching for this tenant/model (set max_batch_latency=0), (3) route tenant to fallback dedicated pool temporarily.
eng_ml_tara: Also recommend switching lexico to the fp16 variant for now — q4 kernel shows pathological latency for many short requests.
sre_dean: Applying emergency scale and disabling continuous batching on the tenant now. Will monitor.
support_lead: Customer asked about cost impact of routing to dedicated pool — will confirm once we have numbers.
incident-bot: incident created: INC-2026-089 — "ingress buffer surge -> 504s" (priority: P1)
eng_runtime_liz: Rolling back today's kernel tweak on canary to rule out regression.
sre_dean: After mitigation: 3m post-change p95 dropped from 3.2s -> 420ms; no 504s in the last 8 minutes. queue_depth trending down.
customer_success: Noted. Preparing customer update + goodwill credit offer.
eng_runtime_liz: Postmortem action items: 1) include queue_depth and drop_rate in autoscale triggers, 2) add tenant-level circuit breaker when drop_rate > 1%, 3) add canary test for continuous-batcher on low-latency, high-frequency workloads, 4) verify sticky routing behavior for high-throughput tenants.
sre_dean: Recording metrics snapshot for the incident: peak_queue_depth=1624, peak_drop_rate=4.3%, p95_before=3.2s, p95_after=420ms. Keeping alert open for 30m clean window.
support_lead: Customer reports improved experience. Keeping thread open until we hit the 30m clean target. :thumbsup:
eng_platform_kevin: I'll follow up with a config PR to expose tenant-level batching toggles in the console.
sre_dean: Thanks team — will add notes to the incident record and assign owners for the follow-ups.
